[[File:C-3PO_EP3.png|250px|thumb|C-3PO was a human-droid relations specialist]]
'''Human-droid relations specialist''' was a specialty classification for [[Droid/Legends|droids]] designed to interact between [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and other droids or computers. [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] was one such droid.
